Subtask: Go to ReservoirUtah and check what resource type it contains. Use NavigateTo(ReservoirUtah) to teleport there, then use GetSupply(ReservoirUtah) to pick up one unit of the resource to identify what type it is (Water or Sand). After getting the supply, use get_agent_state() to check your inventory and report back what you found. The resource type "A" means Water and "B" means Sand.
